correctness.rationale: Two algorithms exactly agree on all 2048 vertex masks, all complexes satisfy downward face closure. Every one of 195 explicit free-face pairs is tested at removal time, leaving precisely the respective lower threshold. On all remaining nontrivial homotopy stages, the complete sequential-element matchings are checked acyclic on every covering incidence, leave one dimensional level of critical faces, and induce integral sphere wedges by discrete Morse theory. All eleven independent reduced mod-two homology calculations agree. There is no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The eleven-vertex Grötzsch graph is a canonical, structurally motivated Mycielski construction with known ordinary suspension topology but previously unresolved observed higher-induced-component filtration. Two actual collapse equivalences preserve the same integral 2-sphere through three thresholds, while exact subsequent wedges and vanishing inclusion maps give a complete natural filtration invariant. This is more than isolated finite Betti numbers or arbitrary parameter substitutions. Scope remains this specific graph; no claim of broad-family theorem.
